title: Sweet Hour of Prayer
lyrics: [C]Sweet hour of prayer Sweet [F]hour of prayer That [C]calls me from a [G]world of care
And [C]bids me at my [F]Father's throne Make [C]all my wants and [G]wishes [C]known
[C]In seasons of distress and grief My soul has often found re-[G]lief
And [C]oft escaped the [F]tempter's snare By [C]Thy return, sweet [G]hour of [C]prayer
Sweet [C]hour of prayer! Sweet [F]hour of prayer!
The joys I feel, this bliss I share
Of those whose anxious spirits burn
With strong desires for Thy return!
With such I hasten to the place
Where God my saviour shows His face,
And gladly take my station there,
And wait for Thee, sweet hour of prayer!
